uart.signal: the committed AVR-GCC ELF compiled with -mmcu=atmega328pb prints `PB_USART1_OK` through USART1 UDR1; the integration test asserts captured serial and PB5 high, and examples/atmega328pb-usart1/io-smoke.yaml asserts the serial marker under `labwired test`. The host AVR-LibC lacks a PB header/startup object, so the example supplies data-space register definitions and a reset vector; USART1 interrupts remain unmodelled.
uart.lane: cargo test -p labwired-core --test avr avr_atmega328pb_usart1::; cargo run -q -p labwired-cli -- test --script examples/atmega328pb-usart1/io-smoke.yaml --output-dir out/boards/atmega328pb-usart1/io-smoke --no-uart-stdout
